name: Freshdesk
description_en:
Freshdesk is a product in the Help desk category. Its directory profile covers AI Assistant, Incident Management, Social Media Integration, Multi-Channel Communication, Macros (Templated Responses), Document Storage, Customizable Branding, Ticket Management.

Additional listed capabilities include Surveys and Feedback, Known Issue Management, Knowledge Base, Contract (SLA Management), Community Forums, Automated Routing, Alerts (Escalation), Self Service Portal. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $15.0. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: use model-assisted interactions within the product workflow; coordinate conversations across supported channels; create, assign and track service requests; organize reusable answers and documentation; use supported language options in relevant workflows; exchange messages with visitors or customers in real time. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Freshdesk 属于客户服务台软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括AI 助手、事件管理、社交媒体集成、多渠道沟通、快捷回复模板、文档存储、品牌自定义、工单管理。

资料还列出问卷与反馈、已知问题管理、知识库、服务水平协议管理、社区论坛、自动分流、升级处理提醒、自助服务门户。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $15.0. 另有持续免费方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在产品工作流中使用模型辅助交互；协调受支持渠道中的沟通记录；创建、分配并跟踪服务请求；整理可复用的答案与说明文档；在相关流程中使用受支持的语言选项；与访客或客户实时交换消息。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
